positions.as_written: Expect a degenerate meniscus to carry less tension than its outline suggests.
Treat the lateral meniscus as the more important one to its compartment, against the frequency of injury.
Treat the five functions as a package that cannot be restored selectively.
Repair at the first operation wherever the ring can be restored, because the decision is not repeatable.
Address root integrity and alignment alongside the meniscus, since both decide whether it works.
